purpose: Authorize exactly one continuation of the relational host-resource empirical analysis after the first v0.1 attempt stopped before T_st/beta_R because three species violated the preexisting duplicate-aligned-header mask admissibility rule.

parent_authorization_v0.1.attempt_state: partial nucleotide identity and species-level distance/IBD computation may have occurred transiently before the structural reader error; no T_st, beta_R, relational decision, result JSON, serialized sequence identity, or serialized edge-distance vector was produced

repair.basis: response-blind FASTA header structure plus the preexisting generic Phase-2 rule duplicate_aligned_header = species inadmissible

species.roles: inherit the original response-blind host-resource design; subtract only the three duplicate-header inadmissible species; no resplitting; reapply the frozen >=5 surviving-source support rule

response_contract.panel_selection: largest exact unique locality count, then larger aligned header count, then lexicographic raw locus identifier; fixed before identity
response_contract.sequence_pair_distance: uncorrected p-distance = canonical A/C/G/T mismatches / jointly canonical columns
response_contract.valid_sequence_pair: jointly canonical columns >= ceil(0.50 * frozen alignment length)
response_contract.locality_pair_distance: arithmetic mean over all valid cross-locality sequence-pair p-distances
response_contract.edge_response: locality-pair distance on the unchanged frozen density-scaled kNN edge
response_contract.source_training_response: post-IBD turnover rank orthogonalized against within-source edge-length rank
response_contract.source_to_target_score: Spearman correlation of the source-only TTF field prediction with target post-IBD turnover

relational_model.covariance: two-way source/target cluster-robust sandwich with dyad intersection subtraction and finite-cluster corrections
relational_model.null_decision: otherwise RELATIONAL_HOST_RESOURCE_NULL_WITH_QUALIFIED_POWER; the repaired survivor synthetic power gate has passed

interpretation.positive: Among the repaired frozen fresh Lepidoptera dyads, species facing more similar larval host-resource landscapes show greater transfer of post-IBD spatial genetic structure after geographic opportunity, broad family membership, source quality, target predictability, and sampling-geometry mismatch are controlled.
interpretation.null: Under repaired-geometry qualified power, the frozen host-resource relation does not explain source-target transfer heterogeneity in the tested Lepidoptera design.
interpretation.limits: Neither branch rewrites the completed unconditional TTF result; this is a separate prospective relational hypothesis.

continuation_rules: Open/continue identity only for the repaired 399-species empirical union.
The three duplicate-header species are excluded solely by the preexisting response-blind mask admissibility rule.
Do not add or drop any other species, dyads, host covariates, controls, or taxonomic groups.
Do not change p-distance, IBD residualization, bandwidth, prior, segment points, source-only field definition, covariance, alpha, or decision rule.
Do not inspect or use transient values from the stopped v0.1 attempt.
This is the only authorized continuation. If another structural failure occurs, stop; no additional repair/rerun is authorized.
No post-result retuning or result-selection rerun is authorized.
